records.summary: 2025-26 catalog (archived): college-level coursework from institutions accredited by the listed associations is evaluated. Bachelor's degree requires 120 hours, 60 of which must be completed at an accredited senior college, and the last 30 hours in residence at UT Knoxville (up to two courses outside the major may be taken elsewhere during the final 30 hours if 25 percent of coursework is completed at UT), plus the SACSCOC 25 percent rule.

residency_rules.text: Complete 60 hours of the minimum 120 at an accredited senior college.
Complete the last 30 hours in residence at UT Knoxville, with the two-course exception.

records.notes: Preserved as prior-year history; superseded for the 2026-27 catalog year. The 60-senior-college-hours rule is not stated as a two-year transfer cap.
